proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the multiplication map m is isomorphic to the projection pr_0 : G x_k G -> G via (g, g') -> (m(g, g'), g'), whose horizontal arrows in the displayed commutative diagram are isomorphisms; the projection is open over a field by the cited morphisms lemma, hence m is open (source lines 948-962)
